title: What Our Homeowners Say
seoDescription: Read why Pohara, Collingwood and Tata Beach homeowners trust us with bookings, guests and the day-to-day care of their Golden Bay holiday homes each year.

testimonials.quote: We have been extremely impressed with the level of service provided by our property managers. They are professional, responsive, and consistently go above and beyond to ensure our properties are well looked after. Communication is clear and timely, and any issues are addressed quickly and efficiently, giving us complete peace of mind. We have absolute confidence in their ability to manage our properties and would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for dedicated, proactive, and highly professional property managers.
testimonials.name: Marion

testimonials.quote: We approached Michael and Katja from Golden Bay Holiday Homes around the middle of 2022 with the idea of letting our home out on Airbnb. This decision has proven to be a very wise one! After some professional negotiating and careful planning, they have taken our property and placed it on the world stage as a 5-star rated holiday home stay. A very professional and well-run business, they have made this transition smooth and hassle-free. We highly recommend them, with every year becoming busier than the last.
testimonials.name: Mark & Tracey

testimonials.quote: I highly recommend Golden Bay Holiday Homes. I moved my property here after experiences of a different company. Katja and Mike have been very easy to deal with, listen to questions and suggestions, respond quickly to contact and are open to suggestions and feedback. The service is individualized and personal with the aim to get the best returns but also to set the price to encourage people to come to the Bay. The standard of cleaning is very good and the finishing touches are professional and inviting for customers. If the property develops any issues, they either sort this themselves if able or can arrange for trades so there is no hassle for me. I have absolutely no regrets.
testimonials.name: Juliet
